name: Sahel insurgency
summary: JNIM insurgency persists across Mali and Burkina Faso; no blockade or fall of a capital reported
state: JNIM remains active across Mali and Burkina Faso, including large attacks on army positions (Arab News; Long War Journal). Searches on 7 Nov found no current blockade or fall of a capital or major city, and no spread of mass-casualty attacks to coastal states, so the insurgency is rated at sustained intensity.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all travel to most of Mali and Burkina Faso.
rubric_hit: Sustained insurgency = Watch; no capital blockade (Alert)

sources.title: Arab News — Deadly militant offensive sweeps northern and eastern Burkina Faso

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
